rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that causes trouble, inconvenience, or worry.

example.english: This form is too troublesome; I’ve spent the whole afternoon on it and still haven’t finished it.
example.traditional: 呢份表格太麻煩，我填咗成個下午都未填完。
example.jyutping: ne1 fan2 biu2 gaak3 taai3 maa4 faan4 ngo5 tin4 zo2 sing4 go3 haa6 ng5 dou1 mei6 tin4 jyun4

rows.note: Use this when the troublesome thing is difficult to handle, fix, or get working, especially in casual speech.

example.english: This old air conditioner is really troublesome; no matter how much we fix it, it won’t turn on.
example.traditional: 呢部舊冷氣真係難搞，整極都唔着。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 gau6 laang5 hei3 zan1 hai6 naan4 gaau2 zing2 gik6 dou1 m4 zoek6

rows.note: Use this specifically when the troublesome thing causes anxiety or concern rather than practical inconvenience.

example.english: It’s really troublesome that they still haven’t called back after so long.
example.traditional: 佢咁耐都未覆電話，真係令人擔心。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gam3 noi6 dou1 mei6 fuk1 din6 waa2 zan1 hai6 ling6 jan4 daam1 sam1
